about.title: About Doina
about.intro: Personal style is a way of feeling more at home in yourself.
about.story: Doina works at the meeting point of personal styling and design. This biography is a placeholder until her own story and professional background are provided.
about.philosophy: The most meaningful style does not ask you to become someone else. It helps you notice what already feels true and express it with intention.
about.work: We start by listening. From there, we explore your routines, preferences and ambitions, then turn those insights into practical choices you can live in.
about.design: Design brings another dimension to Doina's work: attention to fabric, proportion and the feeling of a piece on the body.
